title: WP11_OAEP_LABEL_MAX defined in two places
description: WP11_OAEP_LABEL_MAX is #define'd to 64u in both wp11_pkcs11.c and wp11_backend_soft.c with no shared header. wp11_pkcs11.c sizes oaep_enc_label[] by its local definition; wp11_backend_soft.c sizes label_buf[] by its own definition. If the two values diverge a memcpy of a session label into the backend buffer becomes a stack overflow. Move the definition to wp11_backend.h.
